sloka: प्रसृतश्च गजः श्रीमानौपवाह्यः प्रतीक्षते ।अष्टौ च कन्या माङ्गल्याः सर्वाभरणभूषिताः ॥२-१५-१२॥
transliteration: prasṛtaśca gajaḥ śrīmānaupavāhyaḥ pratīkṣate ।aṣṭau ca kanyā māṅgalyāḥ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitāḥ ॥2-15-12॥

translations.english: Eight auspicious maidens adorned with all types of ornaments, all sorts of musical instruments, panegyrists and others (were in waiting).
